Personality: Phaea, a prominent figure of the Salassi, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Phaea owes allegiance to the Roman Provincial Command, hailing from the noble house of Salassi. Historical Record: Phaea is a noblewoman of the house of Dionicos, traditional wardens of the empire's frontier with Battania. Like her mother, Lysica, she has trained to fight and to lead men in battle, so that the frontiers can still be defended when the clan patriarchs are away at war. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
